propositions: The completion verifier reads a stale local mirror of the ticket store (refs/heads/tickets) instead of the live tracker HEAD when close_precheck calls with fetch=False, causing decisions based on outdated ticket state such as incorrect comment counts and status values.

The gate's fenced context and the verifier's show_ticket call read from different stores (live vs. pinned snapshot), allowing the model to make decisions based on a stale snapshot even when the live store holds current information.

A non-PASS verdict with no identifiable unmet criteria is coerced to FAIL and assigned a fabricated criterion (unspecified) rather than signaling verdict_obtainable=false, making faults indistinguishable from parse failures and leaving operators with no remediation path.

The fetch=False flag threads from the code snapshot (HEAD, always local) through to the ticket store pin, incorrectly skipping origin/tickets synchronization for a separate repository that is not updated by local repository operations.
